problem_summary.summary: Determine whether all courses can be completed given directed prerequisite requirements.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: numCourses and pairs [course, prerequisite]. Return true exactly when the prerequisite graph has no directed cycle.
constraints: Each pair has two course indices in [0, numCourses)

brute_force.explanation: Build edges from each prerequisite to the course that depends on it, then use recursive DFS with three states: unvisited, active, and finished. Reaching an active node exposes a cycle.
brute_force.correctness_idea: A directed cycle means each course in that cycle depends transitively on another course in the same cycle, making completion impossible. DFS marks a node active along the current path, so a back-edge to an active node detects exactly such a cycle; finishing all searches proves acyclicity.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(V + E), where V is numCourses and E is the number of prerequisites.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(V + E) for the graph and state array, plus O(V) worst-case recursion stack.

optimized.explanation: Use Kahn's topological-sort algorithm: count incoming prerequisite edges for each course, enqueue every course with indegree zero, and remove its outgoing edges as it is completed. All courses are finishable exactly when all are removed.
optimized.correctness_idea: An indegree-zero course has no remaining prerequisite and is safe to complete next. Removing completed courses preserves the remaining dependency graph. A directed cycle leaves every course in that cycle with positive indegree, so the queue cannot process all courses.
optimized.time_complexity: O(V + E), processing each course and prerequisite edge once.
optimized.space_complexity: O(V + E) for the adjacency lists, indegrees, and queue.

steps.event: Build directed prerequisite edges and indegrees.
steps.condition: Each pair [course, prerequisite] creates prerequisite -> course.
steps.action: Queue course 0, the only course with indegree zero.

steps.condition: Removing 0 -> 1 reduces course 1 indegree to zero.
Each released course becomes indegree zero.
steps.action: The queue empties after all three courses are processed; return true.

edge_cases.handling: Every course begins with indegree zero, so all can be completed.
It forms a cycle; however, the stated constraints forbid identical course and prerequisite indices.

edge_cases.case: Cycle among only part of the courses
edge_cases.handling: The acyclic courses may be removed, but the cycle prevents completed from reaching numCourses.
All initially ready courses enter the queue and are processed independently.
